name: google-flights-cheapest-oneway
match: book the cheapest one-way flight from {{origin}} to {{destination}}
book the cheapest trade from {{origin}} to {{destination}}
find cheapest one-way {{origin}} → {{destination}} within next 7 days
source_task: Book the cheapest trade from New Jersey to Bangalore for the next week. Any any day in the next week?
leftover: In the opened Google Flights page: set trip to One-way, set passengers/class as needed, change origin to {{origin}} if not prefilled (use airport code, e.g., EWR or DEL), open the price graph/calendar and select the single cheapest departure within the next 7 days. Use jev_choose when deciding among discrete airports/dates/fares. For payment or final booking confirmation use ask_user — do not auto-pay.
